meta.title: For chefs
meta.descriptionPaymentsOn: A shop window, requests, calendar and reviews for private chefs and home cooks. The client pays the deposit in the app; we pay you after the service.
meta.descriptionPaymentsOff: A shop window, requests, calendar and reviews for private chefs and home cooks. No monthly fees and no commission.

zone.title: Be first in your area.
zone.lead: Ao Lume is opening area by area. In each one, the first approved profiles are the ones that get the requests and collect the first reviews.

position.title: A place in your area
position.text: Each chef sets the radius they work in and shows up to anyone searching inside it. Most areas of the country don't have a single approved chef yet.

reputation.title: Reputation takes time
reputation.text: Reviews only come to those who've already had bookings. Whoever starts first builds the reputation that shapes the next clients' choices.

launch.title: Free at launch
launch.text: Creating your profile, appearing in searches and getting requests costs nothing. Any change to the terms is announced 15 days in advance.

demo.title: Try it: this is how a booking arrives.
demo.lead: Clients find you on Ao Lume or through your link, choose a menu and a free day and send a request. Play the chef and take this example request all the way through.

arrives.title: A request arrives
arrives.text: The client picks the menu and a free day and writes what they need. You get it by email and on your dashboard.

accept.title: Accept or suggest another date
accept.text: You have 48 hours to reply. The client sees your answer on the request page.

chat.title: Agree the details in the chat
chat.text: One conversation per booking: allergies, timings, address. Everything is kept on record.

deposit.title: The client pays the deposit
deposit.text: The client pays the deposit in the app and the date goes into your calendar. The rest you settle with the client on the day.

review.title: You get a review
review.text: After the service, the client leaves a review. Only people who booked can review, and you can reply.

pricing.title:
You only pay for each

guaranteed service.
pricing.earlyNote: We charge our first chefs nothing. While we're getting started, payment is arranged directly with you and we take no commission. That's how it will work once we switch payments on, and anyone already here will get at least 30 days' notice.
pricing.text: Nothing for creating your page, nothing for appearing in searches, nothing for getting requests. When the client pays the deposit, the date is guaranteed, and so is our commission of {pct}% of the booking value, taken from that deposit. No booking, nothing to pay.

noChasing.title: No more chasing people who book and vanish
noChasing.text: The deposit confirms the date. No deposit, no booking.

noAsking.title: You never have to ask anyone for money
noAsking.text: The deposit request comes from us, not from you.

yourMoney.title: The money is yours from the first minute
yourMoney.text: We receive it on your behalf and hand it over once the service is done.

calculator.depositNote: For each service, the client pays a {deposit} deposit here to confirm the date. The other {rest} they settle with you, as always.

cost.aPaymentsOn: Creating your profile, appearing in searches and getting requests costs nothing. We only charge when you earn: a commission of {pct}% of the booking value, taken from the deposit the client pays in the app. The current rate is always shown in your dashboard, and any change is announced at least 30 days ahead.
cost.aPaymentsOff: Today, nothing: creating your profile, appearing in searches, getting requests and arranging the service cost nothing at all, and we don't charge commission. Later on there will be a commission on each guaranteed booking, always taken from what the client pays and never charged to you separately. Anyone already here will get at least 30 days' notice.

payout.aPaymentsOn: The client pays the deposit in the app and it's held for you. Once you've completed the service, we transfer it to your IBAN with the commission already deducted, together with a statement showing your tax details, the deposit received, the commission and the amount transferred. The rest of the service is still agreed and paid directly between you and the client.
payout.aPaymentsOff: Directly from the client, however the two of you agree: Ao Lume never touches the money. The app is there to help clients find you, organise the request and keep the conversation.

chefCancels.q: What if I cancel after accepting?
chefCancels.aPaymentsOn: The deposit is refunded to the client in full and we charge no commission. Repeated cancellations are taken into account on your account.
chefCancels.aPaymentsOff: Let the client know through the booking page, so there's a record. Repeated cancellations are taken into account on your account.

data.q: What details do I need to give?
data.aPaymentsOn: Legal name, NIF (tax number), tax address and IBAN, under Dashboard → Billing. The law also requires us to report to the Portuguese Tax Authority (Autoridade Tributária), once a year, how much you received through the platform (DAC7), and we always tell you what was reported.
data.aPaymentsOff: Only what appears on your profile: who you are, where you cook and what you make. While payment is arranged directly with you, we don't ask for your NIF or IBAN.

homeCook.q: I'm a home cook. Can I join?
homeCook.a: Yes. Everyone starts as a Cook and is reviewed by our team before appearing in searches. If you have cookery training, send your certificate and you'll appear as a Chef.

licences.a: Each chef is responsible for the rules that apply to their activity, such as HACCP training and registering the activity with the tax office (Finanças). We'll publish a guide to help.

clientCancels.a: You set your own cancellation policy: flexible, moderate, strict or your own terms. The client sees it before asking.
